title_or_subject: Show HN: OpusScore, an iPhone/iPad app that follows piano scores from microphone input
body:
I built an iPhone/iPad app for piano practice that listens locally through the microphone and follows the current position in a score. The goal is to reduce manual page turning during practice. It supports sample pieces and MusicXML/MXL import.

App/LP: https://tmpacc100.github.io/opusscore/
Store: https://apps.apple.com/jp/app/apple-store/id6783845152
Media kit: https://tmpacc100.github.io/media-kit/

I would appreciate technical and product feedback, especially from people who practice piano or work with digital sheet music.
